semantic_bindings.accelerometer_bias_estimator_prior: OU mean predictor while active; held while disabled
semantic_bindings.magnetometer_acceptance: lastMagDiag().accepted becomes true only after the correction is actually applied
semantic_bindings.magnetic_attempt_counter: the wrapper control counter advances after a forwarded attempt and is not an informative-service certificate
semantic_bindings.live_handoff: the certified tail inherits the actual reached execution
semantic_bindings.accel_bias_release: release enables estimator bias dynamics and does not reset physical accelerometer bias
semantic_bindings.magnetic_information_covariance: lastMagDiag().S records the actual innovation covariance factored by an applied shipping magnetometer correction and is the covariance used by MAGNETIC SERVICE whitening
semantic_bindings.joint_bias_prediction: z=[e_b;b_true] uses [[phi_e I,(1-phi_e) I],[0,I]] with one shared physical-increment column [I;I]. Corrections and projection are separate operations.
semantic_bindings.projection_scope: Positive radius after a finite completed injection; nonpositive radius disables projection; projection changes the estimate but not covariance; invalid attitude injection may bypass projection.
semantic_bindings.integral_innovation: With a single fixed capture origin S_true=q(t)-q(T_c), shipping r_S=-S_hat=e_S-S_true retains the physical potential forcing.
semantic_bindings.magnetic_coordinate_transport: The complete preceding transport may be rectangular between error charts. Dimension compatibility and finite audits do not certify a release map or source-uniform information.
semantic_bindings.point_audit_scope: Supplied finite-error values and structural flags are diagnostic assertions, not a verified source-uniform certificate. Missing bounds, vacuous prefixes and overflow cannot promote completion.
semantic_bindings.held_accelerometer_bias_hold: On feasible held segments without projection-changing or frame/relock events, the bias estimate and its decoupled covariance block are unchanged. Same-history incremental bias is invariant; absolute bias error still carries the shared physical increment. The incremental full-state contraction obstruction does not remove hard-event or release obligations.
semantic_bindings.h18_role: finite bridge until magnetic-reference refinement and implemented accelerometer-bias release; asymptotic contraction is not required on H18
semantic_bindings.a21_tail: recurring magnetically informed asymptotic tail; linear storage contraction plus a finite-error nonlinear small-gain remainder is the productive proof target
semantic_bindings.pr557_negative_result: held-bias identity obstructs one strict full-state H18 incremental contraction formulation; diagnostic scripts are not theorem machinery
semantic_bindings.mag_refinement_completion: On the captured <=~7 degree tilt domain, existing |B|>=20 uT, |B|<=75 uT, horizontal>=15 uT and residual<=2 uT bounds imply the deployed unweighted MagAutoTuner 35% norm and 5% horizontal gates. MAGNETIC SERVICE then gives finite 128-sample/30-s completion and, with the internal 250-update/1-s guard, finite A21 entry.
semantic_bindings.a21_information_route: Use the complete normalized transported information of all A21 gravity/accelerometer, integral pseudo-, and magnetic corrections. A full floor mu>0 yields the linear covariance-metric comparison rho0<=1/(1+mu); MAGNETIC SERVICE alone covers only the heading/axial gyro-bias component.
semantic_bindings.a21_projection_interior: With estimate projection radius 0.4 m/s^2 and physical accelerometer-bias bound 0.22516660498395405 m/s^2, ||e_ba||<0.17483339501604597 m/s^2 keeps projection inactive on the local A21 tail.
semantic_bindings.a21_translation_observability: For constant-parameter scalar active-bias OU-III, the observability minor from four S rows and one attitude-normalized accel row has determinant -Delta^3 tau^3 (1-exp(-Delta/tau))^3, nonzero for positive finite Delta,tau. Time-varying shipping extension remains open.
semantic_bindings.a21_time_varying_observability: The tau-scaled progress-preserving S scheduler plus dt in [0.004,0.006] s and tau in [0.02,12] s gives a uniform positive time-varying translation minor by the extended-Chebyshev property K'''=exp(-integral 1/tau)>0.
semantic_bindings.a21_uniform_detectability: Active accelerometer bias is a strictly stable OU mode in A21. On the neutral quotient, translation is uniformly observable from S recurrence, gravity observes tilt/transverse gyro bias with sensitivity >=g-A_max, and MAGNETIC SERVICE observes heading/axial gyro bias. Strict compact branch cells imply an existential uniform quotient information floor mu_N>0.
semantic_bindings.a21_uniform_controllability: Positive integrated-OU, gyro white-noise, gyro-bias RW and active accelerometer-bias OU driving densities on the compact timing/tau envelope imply uniform complete controllability. Default a_w covariance sync is a bounded PSD prediction increment; bias release is a bounded diagonal covariance floor.
semantic_bindings.a21_local_nonlinear_closure: On tilt<=6 deg and accelerometer-bias error<=0.15 m/s^2, projection is inactive; tuner and refined magnetic-reference schedules are same-history exogenous; smooth MEKF measurement/reset remainder has eta(r)->0. Thus source-uniform linear rho0<1 implies existence of r*>0 with sqrt(rho0)+eta(r*)<1. Roundoff remains additive supply.
semantic_bindings.a21_constructive_small_gain: Once a certified linear rho0 and quadratic remainder slope L2 are enclosed, r*=min(r_guard,(1-sqrt(rho0))/L2). Additive physical/arithmetic supply then gives the practical radius separately.
semantic_bindings.a21_attitude_diversity: No extra excitation assumption: integral(f x B)=Delta v x B-T g x B. With Vmax=5.5 m/s, Bh>=15 uT, |B|<=75 uT, every T>5.60844 s window has positive vector diversity; T=8 s gives floor 43.97475 (m/s^2)uT. Two 8 s subwindows define the 16 s A21 word and, with recurring magnetic service, expose attitude and gyro bias.
